name: machon-haruach-api
description: Machon HaRuach — core APIs modular monolith

scripts.build-ignore-errors: npm run clean && (npx tsc || true) && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build: npm run clean && npx tsc --noEmitOnError false && npm run copy-assets && npm run build:playground
scripts.build:playground: cd src/playground && npx tsc && copyfiles index.html dist/
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && npx tsc -p tsconfig.prod.json --noEmitOnError false && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build-layer: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');fs.mkdirSync('layer',{recursive:true});fs.rmSync('layer/nodejs',{recursive:true,force:true,maxRetries:12,retryDelay:250});fs.rmSync('layer/dependencies.zip',{force:true,maxRetries:12,retryDelay:250});fs.rmSync('layer/dependencies.zip.tmp',{force:true,maxRetries:12,retryDelay:250});fs.mkdirSync('layer/nodejs',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('tools/layer-package.json','layer/nodejs/package.json')" && npm install --omit=dev --no-package-lock --prefix layer/nodejs && node tools/copyLayerMachonPackages.cjs && node tools/copyLayerEmailTemplates.cjs && tsx tools/zipLayer.ts --input layer/nodejs --out layer/dependencies.zip
scripts.rebuild-layer: npm run clean-layer && npm run build-layer
scripts.deploy-dev: npm run build-layer && npm run build:prod && node --max-old-space-size=24576 ./node_modules/serverless/bin/serverless.js deploy --stage dev
scripts.deploy-dev:verbose: npm run build-layer && npm run build:prod && node --max-old-space-size=24576 ./node_modules/serverless/bin/serverless.js deploy --stage dev --verbose
scripts.deploy-demo: npm run build-layer && npm run build:prod && node --max-old-space-size=24576 ./node_modules/serverless/bin/serverless.js deploy --stage demo
scripts.deploy-staging: npm run build-layer && npm run build:prod && node --max-old-space-size=24576 ./node_modules/serverless/bin/serverless.js deploy --stage staging
scripts.deploy-prod: npm run build-layer && npm run build:prod && node --max-old-space-size=24576 ./node_modules/serverless/bin/serverless.js deploy --stage prod
